-- base/versions.tf --
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = ">= 5.0"
    }
  }
}
-- head/.terraform.lock.hcl --
provider "registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws" {
  version     = "5.1.0"
  constraints = ">= 5.0, < 7.0"
}

provider "example.com/acme/foo" {
  version = "1.0.0"
}
-- head/main.tf --
provider "aws" {
  alias  = "west"
  region = "us-west-2"
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  provider = aws.west
  name     = "q"
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "this" {}

resource "random_pet" "this" {}

resource "terraform_data" "this" {}

resource "foo_thing" "this" {}
-- head/modules/bad/main.tf --
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source = "hashicorp/aws"
    }
  }
}

terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source = "acme/aws"
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name = "q"
}
